settings: frozen (admission stops after observed cost exceeds reservation)
history_complete_since (timestamp after newest deleted request start; null before any purge)
unknown_usage: Reservation remains outstanding; absent cost is never zero.

concurrency.scope: all owners, installations, models and days in the company ledger
concurrency.admission: count and insert in one transaction after retained duplicate/reuse lookup
concurrency.missing_finish: indefinite; restart, checkpoint, reconciliation and retention do not release a slot
concurrency.storage: derived from execution state; no new request content or stored counter

retention.known_clock: terminal execution only: last settlement or outcome update; additionally after embedded ID admission expires
retention.registered: indefinite even when accounting is known; no slot release by retention
retention.unknown: indefinite; reservation and frozen state are never cleared by retention

admission.legacy: retained receipts only; absent non-v7 IDs rejected

retention.idempotency: Existing receipts checked first; purged IDs cannot be admitted again; persistent clock floor prevents rollback replay; capacity rejects new inference.
